description: This Java class 'NullFeature' represents a feature with a JSON null value within the Ditto framework. It includes methods for creation, property management, and JSON serialization, and is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.things' package.

classes.name: NullFeature
classes.description: Immutable class representing a feature with a JSON null value, identified by featureId, with methods for JSON serialization and property management.
